subject: ShellPkg/Rm: Extract DeleteDirectory() function
reasons: This is a pure code refactoring that extracts a block of code from CascadeDelete() into a new DeleteDirectory() function, restructuring control flow and lowering indentation
The transformation is not a repetitive pattern across files but a single function restructure in one file
Coccinelle cannot express 'extract N lines from one function into a new function' — it has no notion of function extraction or restructuring logic
The diff involves removing nested if-blocks and inverting error handling, which requires case-by-case reasoning about the control flow semantics
